skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Guides Twitter/X posting, media publishing, engagement, direct messages, follows, and lookups through the belt CLI and inference.sh apps.
skill.summary: Use belt CLI workflows to manage approved Twitter/X posts and engagement actions.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: The static backtick detector produced many Markdown false positives; most table entries, code fences, and documentation links are not executable code. Risk remains because belt CLI commands can post, delete, DM, follow, like, and retweet through a connected X account. No prompt injection language was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Account-changing actions can run through belt commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before post, delete, DM, follow, like, or retweet actions. Show account, target, and content before execution.

remediation.issue: Engagement workflows can be abused for unsolicited outreach.
remediation.suggestion: Add anti-spam guidance, rate limits, and policy checks before DM, follow, like, or retweet actions.

remediation.issue: External skill and CLI installation commands are unpinned.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted package or skill versions and document verification steps before installing belt or related skills.

remediation.issue: Network and authentication boundaries are implicit.
remediation.suggestion: Document that commands use inference.sh and X integrations. Recommend test accounts or limited permissions for automation.

content.value_statement: Managing X posts and engagement across workflows can be repetitive. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through belt CLI commands for posting and account actions.
actual_capabilities: Provides belt CLI commands for posting text tweets.
Shows how to create posts with media URLs.
Includes examples for likes, retweets, DMs, follows, and deletes.
Lists read actions for user profiles and post details.
Connects image and video generation workflows to X posts.
limitations: Requires belt CLI and an authenticated inference.sh and X setup.
Does not provide built-in moderation, rate limiting, or approval workflows.
Examples can perform account-changing actions if executed.
Media posting depends on reachable media URLs.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Campaign Posts
use_cases.description: Draft and publish approved campaign posts with text or media through the CLI.

use_cases.title: Share Developer Updates
use_cases.description: Share release notes, demos, and generated media from a repeatable command workflow.

use_cases.title: Handle Reviewed Follow-Up Actions
use_cases.description: Send approved direct messages or follow-up actions after reviewing customer context.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Basic Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to prepare a short X post about [topic]. Ask for approval before posting.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me post an update with this media URL: [media URL]. Confirm the text, media URL, and account before running any command.

prompt_templates.title: Review Engagement Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a plan to like, retweet, or follow these targets: [links or handles]. Explain each action and wait for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step X campaign workflow for [launch]. Include posts, media, timing, approval checks, and safe use of belt commands.

output_examples.input: I need to post a launch update with a product image.
output_examples.output: The skill can draft the post, confirm the media URL, and run the approved belt posting workflow.
The skill can request the profile lookup through the X user app and summarize the returned profile details.

output_examples.input: Share an AI-generated video on X.
output_examples.output: The skill can guide video generation, capture the media URL, and prepare an approved X post.

best_practices: Review every post, DM, follow, like, retweet, and delete before execution.
Use a dedicated account with limited permissions for automation.
Keep campaign inputs, media URLs, and target handles from trusted sources.
anti_patterns: Running account-changing commands without clear user approval.
Using the skill for bulk unsolicited DMs, follows, likes, or retweets.
Pasting unverified media URLs or target lists into automation prompts.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides belt CLI workflows for X posts, media posts, likes, retweets, DMs, follows, deletes, and lookups.

faq.question: Does it require an X account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an authenticated inference.sh and X integration before account actions can work.

faq.question: Can it schedule posts?
faq.answer: The description mentions scheduling, but the documented examples focus on immediate belt app commands.

faq.question: Can it post images or videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows media posting through a media URL and related generation workflows.

faq.question: Is approval needed before posting?
faq.answer: Approval is strongly recommended before any post, delete, DM, follow, like, or retweet action.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
